{{Quote|Where's&mdash;"''<br />"''Your {{'}}''date''?' Her name is ''Dawn'', by the way.|Emesh Nar and Jahan Cross, regarding Dawn|<ref name="IE 3" />}}
'''Dawn''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] who made her living as an [[Prostitute/Legends|escort]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Etti IV/Legends|Etti IV]] during the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Era]]. In [[3 BBY/Legends|3 BBY]], she was hired by [[Emesh Nar]], the aide to the Imperial [[Ambassador/Legends|ambassador]] [[Blains Vorlin]], for her services and waited for him in his chambers at the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] [[Imperial Embassy (Etti IV)|embassy]]. However, [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]] [[Agent/Legends|agent]] [[Jahan Cross]],<ref name="IE 3" /> who was framed by Nar for the [[Death/Legends|murder]] of the [[Nautolan/Legends|Nautolan]] informant [[Dah'lis Stark]],<ref name="IE 2">[[Agent of the Empire – Iron Eclipse 2|''Agent of the Empire – Iron Eclipse'' 2]]</ref> put Dawn in the chamber's closet without harming her.<ref name="IE 3" />

Cross confronted Nar in order to take the assistant's illegally obtained [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] and killed Nar near the encrypted safe in his room. Dawn departed Nar's quarters per the instructions of the Imperial [[Spy/Legends|spy]], who was reminded of his [[Jens Cross|deceased sister]] when he warned her to leave. She was also cautioned to deny seeing Cross to avoid implication or connection with Nar's death. Dawn was light-skinned with [[Color/Legends|brown]] [[Hair/Legends|hair]] and [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], and wore pink lingerie.<ref name="IE 3" />

==Behind the scenes==
Dawn appeared in the [[Agent of the Empire – Iron Eclipse 3|third issue]] of the ''[[Star Wars: Agent of the Empire]]'' [[Star Wars comic books|comic-book]] series. The issue was written by [[John Ostrander]], illustrated by [[Stéphane Créty]], and published by [[Dark Horse Comics]]<ref name="IE 3" /> [[February 8]], [[2012]].<ref name="Marvel">{{Marvel|url=comics/issue/54012/star_wars_agent_of_the_empire_-_iron_eclipse_2011_3|text=Star Wars: Agent of the Empire - Iron Eclipse (2011) #3}}</ref>
